lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: ... This ends here.
*Bang!*

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Aaaargh!
The enormous spider lets out a shriek as it writhes, then slowly topples over.
And then...
*Thud*
Back in his original form, the man collapses to the ground.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Oh... He's not a spider anymore.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Well, looks like he's alive.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: If that spider-like form was his D-Shadow form...

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: and he's returned to his normal self, then maybe...
Queen shakes the man's body.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Treasure! I smell treasure! Heh! Heh! Heh!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Th-this is bad! Mona's completely broken!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: D-does that guy smell like catnip or something?!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: No, it's not that. Mona just gets like this whenever he discovers treasure.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Okay, Mona. Settle down.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Heh... Hehehe... Hah.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: *Cough, cough* I'm just really sensitive to the scent of treasure...

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: You've got a nose just as good as mine!
Treasure?

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: As I told you before, we steal villains' hearts and make them repent.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: A villain's Treasure is the embodiment of their distorted desires. Once we defeat their Shadow, we can steal it.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: When we take their Treasure, their corrupted heart is set right, and they're compelled to confess their crimes. We call that a Change of Heart.
I see...

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: The D-Shadows are different from the enemies we're used to seeing in Palaces.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: But if Treasure has appeared, that means we can steal his distorted desires.

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: So does that mean he's a good person now?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: I wouldn't say he's turned over a new leaf... but at least he won't try to attack the Ark anymore.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Then people's lives will no longer be in danger. That's a relief.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: Let's confirm that first.
Phantom shakes the man.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: You there. Wake up.
The man jolts upright and looks around him...

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Nngh... Waaaah...!
Then he bursts into tears.

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: H-he's crying! He's bawling his eyes out!

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: What have I done...?!

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: He appears to regret his actions...

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Commander, how do you think we should proceed?
Miranda, arrest him and bring him in for questioning at the A.C.P.U.
For now... our job as the Thieves of Judgment is done.

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Roger that! You're under arrest!
Miranda puts the man in handcuffs.
The man silently watches her do it.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: A Change of Heart, hm? So that's the meaning behind the name "Phantom Thieves of Hearts."

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: I thought it was merely a romantic notion, but you truly do steal people's hearts...
Yeah... I never would've guessed.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: Quite so, stealing someone's heart should be impossible...

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: Yet, looking back on everything that's happened so far, it's the inexplicable that far outweighs the explicable.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: And he's genuinely admitted to his own wrongdoing.
The man slowly raises his head, his eyes unfocused.
He staggers toward me...
*Thud*
Then, he drops to his knees.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: I won't ask for your forgiveness.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Asking for it wouldn't change anything...

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Not after everything I've done.
Yes, you have to pay for what you've done.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: I know. However...

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: My wife is a kind, ordinary person.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: She's far too good for someone like me.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: I'm ashamed to ask this of you... but could you use your power to make sure she doesn't come to any harm?
I'll try, but no promises.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: That's enough for me...

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Thank you.
Just then,
the spiderwebs surrounding us begin to slowly disappear, as if melting away.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: *Sniff, sniff*

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: The smell's changing!
What smell?

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: This smell... Hmm... It's kinda like the Ark's.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Hmm... How do I explain it? It's like the smell here and the Ark's got all swirled together!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: ... Maybe this isn't the Outer Rim after all.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: It's similar... but it could be a Metaverse born from people's cognition of the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: What does "cognition" mean?

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: It's like getting a sense of how that person perceives things.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Hmm... So this is a Metaverse based on this guy's perception of the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: not the real thing?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: That's probably it. The people of the Outer Rim probably weren't caught up in this either.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: So that's what felt so off about this place...

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: So it was only ever a place that resembled the Outer Rim. There were never any residents here.
Aigis, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: I'm detecting a sound... Measuring the reduction in detectable space.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Commander, it appears this Metaverse is collapsing inward from the outer edge.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: What?! Th-then let's get out of here, quick!

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: You're right, we'd best hurry.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Could you take me with you?

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: I don't have the strength to stand.
... Guess you've always been this shameless, huh?
*Rumble*

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: The shaking's getting closer.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Tch. It collapses just like a Palace too!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Run! If we don't hurry, we'll get swallowed up!
I sling the man over my shoulder and run with the group.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: This way!
We barely make it out and return to the Ark.
After handing the man over to Poli, who's investigating the partition where the spiderwebs had disappeared, we head back to our hideout.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: It's a pleasant surprise that we were able to return to the Ark instead of being sent straight back to our world.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: Yeah, looks like we'll get a chance to thank everyone who's helped us out.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Yes, I also think we'll be able to discuss the D-Waves with the Commander.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Since we're here, I wanna explore more of the Ark!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: I still wanna get more pets from Leo-chan, too! But how much time do we have left, anyway...?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: Can't you tell by the smell?
You can smell that?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: Yeah, I can tell how the D-Waves were affecting that guy.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: Just look at the Palace-like world he created. It's obvious he was using the D-Waves.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: But now that we've beaten him, the smell I got from that world is starting to fade. That means the D-Waves are fading too.
Mona flops down on the couch.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: Still, they're not going to disappear anytime soon. All we can do is wait until the time comes.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: Indeed. We've done all we can for now.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: As Mona said, all that remains is to wait.
That's true, but...
I look at Mona.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: What?
He's a cat.
I've been meaning to ask you, why did you turn into an actual cat?

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: I was about to ask the same thing.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: I'd love to say I'm not a cat...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: but I can't exactly deny it this time.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: Let's just say this is a temporary disguise to fool the world!
I-I see.

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: You're so cute!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: Hey! Don't pet me!
Mona breaks free from Miranda and looks at me again.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: So, Commander, what are you gonna do now?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: I think we should stick around here for a while...
I've got to get back to work.
I've got some catching up to do after all this.

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Oh! I'd better get back to work!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: I've been playing a phantom thief for way too long!

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: Come to think of it, I've left the library unattended for far too long.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: So you all have to work, huh? What about you, Quency?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I've got time. Wanna hang out?

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: I wanna hang out with Quency-chan too!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_2
lines.text: Come to think of it... what's taking those two so long in the bath?
The door opens with a click.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: Sorry we took so long.

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: We didn't mean to keep you waiting.
You guys changed your clothes?

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: Yukiko did. As for me...

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: It's less that I changed clothes and more that I reverted from my thief outfit to my normal self.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: Mona and I automatically transform whenever we're in high-security areas.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: It's more like switching states than actually changing clothes.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: I guess the D-Shadows and that man still had us under surveillance, so we couldn't revert to our normal selves.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: But now the fight's over.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: I see... It's based on the same principle as Mona.

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: So it's the same for Mona too... I was really surprised when Queen suddenly switched back earlier.

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: But it's not like that for me. This kimono was made for me by Ade-san.

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: I thought it'd be nice to have something comfortable to wear around, so I asked her...

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: It feels exactly like the kimono I usually wear! Isn't that amazing? All I did was show her a picture.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: It suits you very well. I take it you wear it often.

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: Hehe, thank you!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Aigis-chan, aren't you gonna get changed?

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: No, simply cleaning my weapons is sufficient.
After the three of them take a seat,
I bring Queen and Yukiko up to speed on our earlier discussion, explaining that it'll take some time for the D-Waves to disappear completely.
So...

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: Yes?
Since we've got some time to kill, want to take a look around the Ark?
It sounds kind of weird to say this, but it's not every day you get to visit another world.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: That's... true.

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: Sightseeing in another dimension...

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: Hahaha, it really does sound ridiculous, but I think it'd be fun.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: Yeah, we may never get another chance like this, so I'd love it if you could show us around and tell us about the facilities here.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: And... I should thank everyone who's been looking after us.

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: Oh, me too! I have to get in touch with Leona-san!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: Well... now that the situation's been resolved, could I introduce myself again?
Introduce yourself again?

lines.speaker: ce009_01_2
lines.text: Yes. Up until now, you've known me by my codename...

lines.speaker: ce009_01_f
lines.text: But my real name is Makoto Niijima. I'd really like it if you called me Makoto from now on.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Mako-chan! Gotcha, I've memorized it!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_c
lines.text: And I'm Morgana.
Makoto and Morgana. It's nice to finally know your real names.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_f
lines.text: Hehe, yeah.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_c
lines.text: Good to officially meet you too!
Well... Makoto, Morgana, and everyone else,
if there's somewhere you'd like to go, just let me know. I'll see what I can do.

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: Commander, do you have hot springs here? I'd love to see what they're like in another world...

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Hmm... The last time I visited the Central Government, I came across a place that piqued my interest.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: I would be pleased if I had the opportunity to tour it.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_c
lines.text: Everyone seems pretty excited...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_c
lines.text: In that case, maybe I'll do a little sightseeing myself. I wonder if they've got any sushi places around here, hehehe!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: I'm gonna ask Ade-chan to make me a parfait!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Then I'll be surrounded by Cocoa-chan, Soda-chan, and Vel-chan, and be one fluffy master!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Oh, I want some too!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Oh! I'll grab some for Poli and Quiry too!

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: In that case, I'll come along as well.
Are you sure you don't want to hang out together?

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: phantom_c
lines.text: So long as we bear the name of the phantom thieves, our paths shall cross again.
O-okay.
I watch the group leave the hideout in pairs, one after another.
Soon, I'm the only one left.
*Clink*
I take a sip of my coffee, now cooled to the perfect drinking temperature.
... Maybe I'll get some rest.
I have no idea how long this adventure with the phantom thieves from another world will last,
but for now, I decide to enjoy the peace and...

lines.speaker: ce009_02_f
lines.text: Oh, Leona-san!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Hey! How've you been?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I heard you were staying here, so I thought I'd stop by—T-Timi!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Aaaaah!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: That's not food! That's the talking bear we saw before!

lines.speaker: timi
lines.text: Roar?
But first, I'd have to deal with that.
